description.purpose: Per-user marketing acquisition cost: each channel-month's spend divided evenly across the users that channel acquired that month. One row per user. Organic users cost 0 (unpaid by nature, not unknown); referral users carry the per-signup bounty as their exact cost. Spend in a channel-month that acquired nobody is unallocated and absent here, so the total is less than marketing_spend_monthly's total. Per-user costs within a cohort can sum a few cents off that cohort's spend due to rounding.

properties.description: Matches core.seed_users.user_id and finance's transaction user ids.
properties.name: user_id

properties.description: Channel that acquired the user, including unpaid ones (organic, referral).
properties.name: channel

properties.description: Campaign that acquired the user. Descriptive only — allocation happens at channel grain, not campaign grain.
properties.name: campaign

properties.description: Exact timestamp the user was acquired, before truncation to acquisition_month.
properties.name: acquired_at

properties.description: First day of the month the user was acquired; the month whose spend is divided.
properties.name: acquisition_month

properties.description: True iff the channel appears in marketing_spend_monthly. Distinguishes a 0 that means 'unpaid channel' (false) from a 0 that means 'paid channel with no spend that month' (true).
properties.name: channel_is_paid

properties.description: The user's share of their channel's spend in their acquisition month, in EUR. Zero for unpaid channels; never NULL, never negative.
properties.name: marketing_cost_eur
